# Security Policy

## Supported versions

This repository is a rolling personal configuration. Only the current default
branch is supported.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for vulnerabilities, exposed credentials, or other
sensitive reports.

Use GitHub's **Report a vulnerability** button on the repository's
[Security page](https://github.com/sahilsasane/dotfiles/security) when it is
available. If it is not available, contact the repository owner privately
using the contact information on the
[maintainer's GitHub profile](https://github.com/sahilsasane).

Include the affected file or component, the impact, reproduction steps, and
any suggested mitigation. You should receive an acknowledgement within seven
days. Please allow time for a fix before disclosing the report publicly.
